subject: ShopLine consumption projection, unit-price target & trial credit approval
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@shopline.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Recap from today — consumption assumptions & next steps

Thanks again for the call this morning, Sophie — good conversation and very helpful to see the demo usage patterns. Quick recap and asks so we’re all aligned: 

Assumptions I captured (please correct where I’m off):
- Primary use case: product recommendations + cart assistants (server-side calls at checkout and cart pages)
- Estimated traffic: ~20M tokens/month in steady state, with peaks up to 2x on sale days
- Per-request shape: many short prompts (avg ~200 tokens in + 80 tokens out)
- Latency SLO: 200–400ms p95 for interactive flows
- Target unit-econ target you mentioned: <= $120 per 1M tokens (goal to hit <$100 long term)

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm the 20M tokens/month estimate (or provide a best/worst band). If you can attach a 48-hour sample of request rates or a tiny CSV with timestamps, that would be ideal.
2) Confirm your preferred budget band for an initial pilot (weekly burn expectations).
3) If you want us to extend the trial and top up credits, we’ll need a simple PO number or acceptance email that we can attach to the credit.

What I can do from Redwood:
- I’m prepared to approve a pilot credit top-up to cover an extended evaluation so you can validate the 20M/month band. Need confirmation of the expected burn cadence before finalizing amount.
- We can also put a short-term routing policy in place (low-latency tier during business hours) to keep costs predictable while you evaluate.

Please reply with the CSV/sample and whichever budget band you want us to size for. Happy to set a 15-minute sync after you share numbers to lock the credit amount and timeline.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

--

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@shopline.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap from today — consumption assumptions & next steps

Thanks, Vivek — really helpful summary. Quick answers below and I attached a small sample export from our staging traffic.

Confirmed numbers:
- Expected steady state: 18–22M tokens/month (we’ll plan for 22M as a conservative estimate).
- Peak days (seasonal/promos): can reach ~40M tokens/day (short spikes).
- Typical daily burn early in pilot: 600k–800k tokens/day (we expect this to ramp).
- Budget range for trial evaluation: $1,800–$2,700 per month while we prove out UX and latency. Beyond pilot we’ll look to negotiate directionally lower unit price as volumes ramp.

Target unit price: your note of $120/1M tokens is in the ballpark — we’d be thrilled if Redwood can land at or below $100/1M at steady state, but for the pilot $120 is reasonable.

Request: can you top up $10k–$12k in trial credits and extend the trial window by 30 days? That would let us run the ramp and validate both cost and latency.

PO / procurement: we can send a simple email acceptance from procurement if you need a PO number — I’ll follow up after I confirm internal approvals.

Thanks — attached: shopline_token_sample.csv

Best,
Sophie Turner
Senior Product Manager, ShopLine Retail
support: +1 415-555-0198

--
Attachment: (stub) shopline_token_sample.csv (text/csv)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@shopline.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap from today — consumption assumptions & next steps

Great — thanks for the sample, Sophie. I reviewed the CSV and the shape looks consistent with what we discussed. Two quick items before I finalize the credit amount: 

1) Unit economics we’ll apply for the pilot (internal note, sharing for transparency):
   - Pilot price benchmark: $120 / 1M tokens as discussed
   - Estimated burn at 22M tokens/month -> $2,640/month at $120/1M
   - If you want a 30-day extension + buffer for spikes, a $12,000 credit will cover ~4.5 months at that pilot rate (or shorter if you hit spikes).

2) Controls & acceptance: 
   - We’ll apply a consumption cap and alerts so we can prevent unexpected overburn.
   - Please provide a PO number or a procurement acceptance email so we can attach it to the credit transaction.

Action: I can provision a $12,000 trial credit top-up and bump the trial window by 30 days once procurement sends the PO/acceptance. Attaching a two-line acceptance template for your procurement team to copy-paste if helpful.

Next sync: if you prefer, we can do a 15-minute call tomorrow to confirm the PO text and set the billing guardrails.

Regards,
Vivek

--
Attachment: (stub) trial-terms-ack.txt
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@shopline.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap from today — consumption assumptions & next steps

Looping in internal approvals — happy to greenlight the $12k credit with the following conditions: 
- Credit will be logged against deal DL-7831 in HubSpot and applied as an upfront billing credit.
- We’ll set an automated alert at 80% of the expected burn (i.e., ~17.6M tokens/month equivalent) and a hard cap at 200% of the conservative estimate to avoid runaway charges.
- Finance requires a short acceptance note from ShopLine (procurement email or PO number) to record the promotional credit.

Related links: HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7831 | DocuSign pilot ACK template: https://app.docusign.com/templates/REDWOOD-PILOT-ACK

I’ll coordinate the billing side once Sophie sends the PO; Vivek, Lauren — confirm and I’ll push the credit into the billing queue.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@shopline.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap from today — consumption assumptions & next steps

Thanks everyone — procurement just sent over the PO and attached the PDF (PO #PO-987). I’ve attached the PDF to this thread for your records.

We accept the $12,000 credit and the 30-day extension with the monitoring guardrails you described. Our procurement contact is Maya Nair (maya.nair@shopline.com) if you need the official signature file.

Next steps on our side:
- We’ll ramp to the 600k–800k tokens/day band in the next 10 business days and share a follow-up sample after the first 72 hours.
- Schedule the 15-minute call to confirm routing preferences and alert thresholds — how does Friday 10:00am PT look?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to push this through.

Best,
Sophie
